common.role: Swiss intermediation and technology platform for tokenised real assets
common.placeholderText: This content will be legally reviewed and completed before the platform launches. The points below show what will be covered here.

footer.roleText: LIQUODA is an intermediation and technology platform based in Switzerland. LIQUODA is not a bank, not a financial institution, not an asset manager and not a custodian. LIQUODA never holds money, tokens or wallet keys and does not provide investment advice.
footer.riskText: Participations in projects on LIQUODA are entrepreneurial investments. Loss of the invested capital is possible. There is no guarantee and no statement about returns.

hero.title: Participations in real assets, structured and traceable.
hero.lead: LIQUODA brings issuers and investors together. Owners of companies, real estate, energy projects or tangible assets present a project. Private individuals can participate from CHF 100. Shares are represented as tokens on the Polygon blockchain.
hero.note: LIQUODA is not a bank, not an asset manager and does not provide investment advice. Every participation carries entrepreneurial risk.

whatIs.title: What LIQUODA is and what it is not
whatIs.lead: So you can place the role of the platform.
isItems: an intermediation platform: it brings issuers and investors together.
a technology platform: it keeps shares in a public, tamper-proof record and documents the process.
non-custodial: money and shares stay with the parties involved. LIQUODA has no access to the shares accounts.
structured: every project goes through the same, traceable process.
transparent: risks are named, not hidden.
isNotItems: a bank, a financial institution, an asset manager or a custodian.
an investor, a guarantor or an investment adviser.
a trading or speculation platform. There is no secondary market.
a place that holds money or shares.
a source of profit or return promises.
whatIs.principle: LIQUODA does not replace risk. LIQUODA makes risk visible, structured and traceable.

roles.title: Who LIQUODA is for
roles.issuersText: SMEs, entrepreneurs and owners of real estate, energy projects or tangible assets such as watches, art or vehicles who want to release capital without selling the asset entirely.
roles.investorsText: Private individuals who want to participate in real assets with CHF 100 to 20'000 and understand where their money goes and which risks exist.

steps.title: How a participation works
steps.lead: Five steps, from an investor's perspective. The process for issuers is described on the page “How it works”.

items.title: Understand
items.text: You read what LIQUODA is, what it is not and which risks a participation carries.

items.title: Review the project
items.text: You see the description, purpose, target amount, term, documents and the section “Risks and notes”.

items.title: Account and identity
items.text: You create an account and verify your identity. Your shares account is set up automatically.

items.title: Amount and consent
items.text: You enter an amount, read the summary and actively agree to the risks. Payment is made in CHF.

items.title: Confirmation
items.text: After successful payment and checks, your shares are allocated to your shares account. Your portfolio shows the participation, documents and project status.

examples.title: Example projects
examples.lead: Three projects from the marketplace. All projects are examples and show how a project is presented on LIQUODA. Participations are not yet possible.

items.title: The role of LIQUODA
items.text: LIQUODA intermediates and provides the technology. LIQUODA is not a party to the participation and holds neither money nor shares.

items.title: Entrepreneurial risk
items.text: Every participation is an entrepreneurial investment. The invested capital can be lost in full or in part.

items.title: No guarantee, no statement about returns
items.text: LIQUODA makes no commitments regarding income, repayment or value development. Information provided by issuers is reviewed but not guaranteed.

items.title: Transparent process
items.text: Every step shows where you are, what happens next and what consequence your action has.

items.title: Cancellation and failure
items.text: If the funding target is not reached, no shares are issued and payments are refunded in full. A cancelled process creates no obligation.

howItWorks.metaDescription: The process on LIQUODA, step by step, for investors and issuers.
howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.lead: LIQUODA guides both sides through the same process. Here you see what happens in which order, without technical detail.
howItWorks.investorsIntro: From first orientation to the participation in your portfolio.

investorSteps.title: Understand what LIQUODA is
investorSteps.text: The home page explains the role of the platform, the risks and the process. Only then should you continue.

investorSteps.title: Discover projects
investorSteps.text: You see all active projects, filter by asset type and recognise the status: open, funded or closed.

investorSteps.title: Review a project
investorSteps.text: The project page shows the description, purpose, target amount, term, documents and the section “Risks and notes”.

investorSteps.title: Create an account and verify identity
investorSteps.text: You register as an investor and verify your identity (KYC). Your shares account is set up automatically; there is nothing to install.

investorSteps.title: Enter an amount and confirm the conditions
investorSteps.text: You enter an amount between the minimum and CHF 20'000, read the summary and actively agree to the risks. Payment is made in CHF.

investorSteps.title: Confirmation and shares
investorSteps.text: After successful payment LIQUODA checks project status, term and identity. Only if everything is fulfilled are your shares allocated to your shares account. You receive an email about it.

investorSteps.title: Portfolio
investorSteps.text: Your portfolio shows participations, documents, project status and the public record of your shares.

howItWorks.issuersIntro: From the enquiry to the close of the funding round.

issuerSteps.title: Get informed
issuerSteps.text: The page “For issuers” describes benefits, process, requirements and costs.

issuerSteps.title: Project enquiry
issuerSteps.text: You send an enquiry with key data: asset type, purpose, estimated amount. LIQUODA responds with a first assessment.

issuerSteps.title: Create an account and verify the company
issuerSteps.text: You register as an issuer and go through the company verification (KYB).

issuerSteps.title: Enter the project
issuerSteps.text: In the project wizard you enter information, documents, target amount and term.

issuerSteps.title: Review
issuerSteps.text: The project receives the status “under review”. LIQUODA asks questions, you adjust. Approval is always manual.

issuerSteps.title: Approval and launch
issuerSteps.text: After approval the project becomes visible and the funding phase begins.

issuerSteps.title: Funding phase and close
issuerSteps.text: You follow the state of the round. If the target is reached, the round is closed. If it is not reached, the round is reversed.

howItWorks.failureTitle: What happens on cancellation or failure
howItWorks.failureLead: These cases are part of the process and are shown just as clearly on the platform.

failureItems.title: Funding target not reached
failureItems.text: The project is marked as “funding not successful”. No shares are issued. Payments already made are refunded automatically and in full, and investors are informed by email.

failureItems.title: Payment failed
failureItems.text: You receive a neutral message with possible causes. A new payment is possible.

failureItems.title: Identity verification not passed
failureItems.text: You receive factual information about which details are missing and can submit them or get in touch.

failureItems.title: Participation cancelled
failureItems.text: You receive confirmation that no obligation has arisen.

failureItems.title: Project not approved
failureItems.text: The issuer sees the status with a factual reason and notes on how to adjust.

failureItems.title: Project ended early
failureItems.text: All parties see the reason, the consequences and the next steps.

issuers.metaDescription: Benefits, process, requirements and packages for issuers on LIQUODA.
issuers.title: For issuers
issuers.lead: You own a company, a property, an energy project or a tangible asset and want to release capital without selling the asset entirely. LIQUODA provides a structured process and the technology for this. In legal terms, issuers are the parties that issue shares in their company, property, project or tangible asset.

benefits.title: A clear process
benefits.text: From the enquiry to the close of the round, every project follows the same steps. You always know where your project stands.

benefits.title: Standardised project page
benefits.text: Your project is presented uniformly with description, target amount, term, documents and risk notes.

benefits.title: Shares in a public record
benefits.text: Shares are kept in a public record on Polygon using audited standard contracts. There is no custom contract logic.

benefits.title: Documents in one place
benefits.text: Contracts and documents are stored with versioning and made accessible to investors.

requirements: Registered office or asset in Switzerland.
A concrete project with a clear purpose, target amount and term.
Willingness to disclose documents and answer questions.

collateral.title: Collateral

explain.none: The issuer provides no collateral. The participation is covered solely by the success of the project.
explain.pledge: The issuer provides a pledge, for example a mortgage or a pledge on a tangible asset. In case of loss the pledge can be realised; the proceeds may be below the invested capital.
explain.guarantee: A third party or a contract secures part of the payments, for example a surety or a purchase agreement. The collateral is only as good as the solvency of that third party.
explain.milestone_payout: The capital is released to the issuer step by step after agreed milestones are reached. This reduces the risk of misuse, not the project risk.

collateral.disclaimer: The collateral is governed by the contract between issuer and investors. LIQUODA does not assess, verify or guarantee it and offers no insurance of its own.

datenschutz.title: Privacy policy
datenschutz.lead: How LIQUODA handles personal data under the Swiss Data Protection Act (DSG).

sections.title: Responsible party
items: LIQUODA, operated by Marcel Spahr, Schwarzenburgstrasse 65, 3008 Bern. Contact: info@liquoda.com.

sections.title: Which data is collected
items: Waiting list: first name, last name, email address and selected role.
Project enquiry: name, company, email address, asset type, estimated amount and description.
After the platform launches, additionally: identity verification data (KYC/KYB), wallet address and payment references. These points will be added before launch.

sections.title: What the data is used for
items: Exclusively to inform you about the launch and to process your enquiry.
No transfer to third parties, no advertising, no profiling, no sale.
No personal data is stored on the blockchain.

sections.title: Your rights
items: You have the right to access, correct and delete your data at any time. Write to info@liquoda.com.

risiken.title: Risk disclosure
risiken.lead: What you should know before participating in a project.

sections.title: Entrepreneurial risk
items: Every participation is an entrepreneurial investment. Success depends on the project and the issuer.
The invested capital can be lost in full or in part.

sections.title: No guarantee, no statement about returns
items: LIQUODA makes no commitments regarding income, repayment or value development.
Information provided by issuers is reviewed but not guaranteed.

sections.title: No tradability
items: There is no secondary market. Tokens are not freely transferable and cannot be sold on LIQUODA.
Expect your participation to be locked until the end of the term.

sections.title: Technical risks
items: Your shares are kept in a shares account that is set up automatically with your login. Its key is split between a specialised service provider and your browser; LIQUODA has no access to it.
If you lose access to your LIQUODA account and your email address, access to your shares is affected as well. LIQUODA cannot replace shares.
The public record (Polygon) is operated by third parties. Disruptions there can delay the allocation or display of shares.

sections.title: Planned content
items: LIQUODA is not a party to the participation between issuer and investor.
LIQUODA does not provide investment advice and makes no recommendations on individual projects.
Content on project pages comes from the issuers. LIQUODA checks completeness but gives no warranty for accuracy or success.
Liability for availability of the platform, outages and maintenance.
Liability for third-party blockchain networks and wallets.
